policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply
policies.n: German nationals require a DPRK visa and a Korean invitation; for tourism the travel organiser arranges the invitation. The Foreign Office describes organised travel with accompanying personnel and foreign-ministry approval. This establishes visa duty, not that tourism is open, a visa will be issued, or admission is assured. Stay and currently available issuance arrangements are unconfirmed.

policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply
policies.n: Slovenian citizens require a DPRK visa. The MFA describes state-agency organised tourism and accompanied travel; independent travel requires special permission and is normally limited to business. Visa duty does not establish that tourism is open or that a visa or entry will be granted. No fixed tourist stay or presently available issuance channel is established.

policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply
policies.n: Belgian ordinary travellers require a visa obtained through the embassy/consulate via a travel organisation recognised by DPRK or on a DPRK invitation. The live government checker retains a20 October2023 record; it establishes visa duty, not current tourism opening or routine issuance. No admitted stay is specified. The checker’s90-day search scope is not a90-day entry permission.

policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply
policies.n: Portuguese travellers require an Iranian visa. Portuguese MFA says airport issuance remains suspended and recommends obtaining the visa before travel. Final electronic-versus-consular issuance and admitted stay remain unconfirmed; its one-month visa-validity wording is not a stay grant. BOCA’s expressly foreign-applicant-wide rule requires a legally registered Iranian travel agency to file the visa application and arrange the itinerary. That applicant rule does not revoke independently established exemptions.

policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply
policies.n: Spanish nationals require an Iranian visa throughout their stay. The embassy says airport issuance was suspended and no official resumption has been communicated; online preapplication is not proof of a final eVisa. Stay and final issuance method remain unconfirmed. Passport must be valid more than six months; the embassy warns that an Israeli visa or stamp in a travel document prevents entry. BOCA’s expressly foreign-applicant-wide rule requires a legally registered Iranian travel agency to file the visa application and arrange the itinerary. That applicant rule does not revoke independently established exemptions.

policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply
policies.n: Italian travellers require an Iranian visa. The live MFA country PDF calls for obtaining it before departure; its detailed online-registration, consular-presentation and conditional-airport passages do not prove interchangeable operational methods. Keep final method and admitted stay unconfirmed. A valid visa does not guarantee entry; the source also excludes passports bearing an Israeli visa or entry stamp. BOCA’s expressly foreign-applicant-wide rule requires a legally registered Iranian travel agency to file the visa application and arrange the itinerary. That applicant rule does not revoke independently established exemptions.

policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply
policies.n: Czech tourist guidance requires presentation of the issued Iranian visa sheet with the passport at entry and retention of it for exit. It reports anAugust2025 rule allowing tourist applications only for Iranian-agency-organised tours and rejection of independent tourist applications. Applications are filed electronically, but final issuance method and stay are unconfirmed. Passport must remain valid at least six months after visa expiry. BOCA’s expressly foreign-applicant-wide rule requires a legally registered Iranian travel agency to file the visa application and arrange the itinerary. That applicant rule does not revoke independently established exemptions.

policies.label: Visa required; issuance conditions apply
policies.n: Ordinary tourist entry requires a visa under Article11 of the Entry-Exit Law, read with Immigration’s published ordinary/unilateral exemption schedule and known later exceptions. Diplomatic/service exemptions do not cover ordinary passports. This is requirement-only: arrival eligibility, electronic eligibility, any advance clearance and the admitted stay are unconfirmed. The law’s generic power to issue visas at checkpoints is not an entitlement for this nationality. An accepted travel document and any applicable special authorisation are still necessary; no routine issuance or admission is promised.
